column1: akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-kawasaki-ninja-1000,akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-kawasaki-ninja-1000,Akrapovic Racing Full Exhaust System for Kawasaki Ninja 1000,Akrapovic Racing Full Exhaust System for Kawasaki Ninja 1000,akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-kawasaki-ninja-1000,"Akrapovic Racing Exhaust System Kawasaki Ninja 1000 / Z1000 • High quality stainless steel headers and mid-pipes. • No fuel remapping required, but for optimal performance RevZilla recommends use of a fuel controller. • A combination of beautiful machine and hand welds. • Patented hexagonal muffler.","Akrapovic Racing Exhaust System Kawasaki Ninja 1000 / Z1000

The Akrapovic Racing Line has been designed specifically for demanding riders and represents an ideal balance between price and performance. The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The Racing Line is identical to Akrapovic’s top range Evolution Line exhaust systems, with the major difference being the material that is used for the headers and mid-pipes. The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.
• High quality stainless steel headers and mid-pipes
• No fuel remapping required, but for optimal performance RevZilla recommends use of a fuel controller
• A combination of beautiful machine and hand welds
• Lightweight, compact and high-temperature-resistant carbon fiber muffler clamp
• All carbon fiber parts are produced in-house
• Air-tight quality controlled production means your exhaust will be perfect

Akrapovic Racing Exhaust System Kawasaki Ninja ZX-14R

The Akrapovic Racing Line has been designed specifically for demanding riders and represents an ideal balance between price and performance. The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The Racing Line is identical to Akrapovic’s top range Evolution Line exhaust systems, with the major difference being the material that is used for the headers and mid-pipes. The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.

22 years of exhaust manufacturing technology has gone into producing this Evolution Line exhaust, but despite this – just like Ducati in building the Panigale – the design effort Akrapovic put into making the ultimate exhaust was the most challenging the Slovenian company had ever faced. However, they have ensured that the finished product upholds the fact that Evolution Line exhausts are the finest off-the-shelf racing systems available.

The Akrapovic Evolution Exhaust System is the flagship of the Akrapovic exhaust line. Developed and tested by Akrapovic’s top factory teams by riders at the pinnacle of racing, it is simply the finest performance exhaust system available. Each Akropovic exhaust is dedicated to maximizing the performance of an engine, while reducing overall weight, to optimize the handling of your motorcycle. The key feature of the Akrapovic EVO Exhaust System is the full titanium header and mid-pipes. Made from… • High quality stainless steel headers and mid-pipes. • No fuel remapping required, but for optimal performance RevZilla recommends use of a fuel controller. • A combination of beautiful machine and hand welds. • Patented hexagonal muffler.","The Akrapovic GP-styled Racing Exhaust is a high-performance exhaust that takes design cues from the exhaust found on the factory Yamaha SBK bike. Made from stainless steel, a race-proven material, this exhaust system results in a boost in performance and noticeable weight reduction.

The Akrapovic Racing Line has been designed specifically for demanding riders and represents an ideal balance between price and performance. The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The Racing Line is identical to Akrapovic’s top range Evolution Line exhaust systems, with the major difference being the material that is used for the headers and mid-pipes. The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.

The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The Racing Line is identical to Akrapovic’s top range Evolution Line exhaust systems, with the major difference being the material that is used for the headers and mid-pipes. The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.

Akrapovic Racing Exhaust System Kawasaki Versys 650

The Akrapovic Racing Line has been designed specifically for demanding riders and represents an ideal balance between price and performance. The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.

column1: akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-yamaha-mt-09,akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-yamaha-mt-09,Akrapovic Racing Full Exhaust System for Yamaha MT-09,Akrapovic Racing Full Exhaust System for Yamaha MT-09,akrapovic-racing-full-exhaust-system-for-yamaha-mt-09,"Akrapovic is proud to introduce a stunning Racing Line exhaust for the Yamaha FZ-09. The FZ-09 is a bike with a strong focus on riding… • High quality stainless steel headers and mid-pipes. • No fuel remapping required, but for optimal performance RevZilla recommends use of a fuel controller. • A combination of beautiful machine and hand welds. • CNC machined muffler inlet cap.","Akrapovic is proud to introduce a stunning Racing Line exhaust for the Yamaha FZ-09. The FZ-09 is a bike with a strong focus on riding emotion and represents a new direction in sport-bike evolution. A bike designed to give homage to the darker and unconventional side of Japanese society can now be made even more mean, moody and exciting with the addition of Akrapovic's offering.

The Akrapovic Racing Titanium system is constructed from high quality stainless steel with a titanium alloy outer sleeve on the muffler body. A  ‘slash-cut’ outlet section has been designed to retain the narrow lines of the FZ-09 and has a removable baffle plate, which features three stylish exit ports. Peak power gain of 5.4HP at 9900 rpm and peak torque of 3.9lb-ft at 5000 rpm. Increased power-to-weight ratio with weight reduction of 5.3 lb compared to stock exhaust.

The Akrapovic Racing Carbon Fiber system, with its striking carbon fiber outer-sleeve and stainless steel headers, suits the naked design of the Yamaha bike and this exhaust will certainly bring the best out of the high-torque 3-cylinder engine that beats inside the heart of the Yamaha. Producing an extra 4.7lb-ft of torque at 5,150 rpms and increased power output of 6.8HP, the Racing Line (Carbon) will produce powerful and thrilling performance in everyday conditions, as well as help to improve the overall experience of the machine thanks to a weight saving 8.4lb from the original system!

The Akrapovic Racing Line has been designed specifically for demanding riders and represents an ideal balance between price and performance. The exhaust systems are dramatically lighter compared to stock exhaust systems and feature exceptional production quality and increased engine performance combined with pure racing sound output. The headers and mid-pipes are constructed of high-quality stainless steel conical tubes with precision handcrafting. A special process known as hydroforming is used in the manufacturing of the exhaust pipes. This process injects pressurized water into each tube to form the ideal shape for optimum exhaust flow without causing creases or compromising the strength of the steel.

Akrapovic Exhaust’s unique design enables them to obtain the maximum output for each specific model of motorcycle, while significantly reducing overall weight. It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. All Akrapovic exhaust system measurements are formulated on in-house computer-controlled flow benches.

The Racing Line is identical to Akrapovic’s top range Evolution Line exhaust systems, with the major difference being the material that is used for the headers and mid-pipes. The headers and mid-pipes of the Evolution Line are constructed exclusively of titanium while the Racing Line uses stainless steel.
• High quality stainless steel headers and mid-pipes
• No fuel remapping required, but for optimal performance RevZilla recommends use of a fuel controller
• A combination of beautiful machine and hand welds
• All carbon fiber parts are produced in-house
• Air-tight quality controlled production means your exhaust will be perfect

column1:
Akrapovic rear exhaust for the G29 Z4 M40i combines a great sound, exceptional engineering, and advanced materials to form the ultimate expression of exhaust engineering.

This Z4 M40i performance exhaust replaces the rear muffler only (from the axle back). This is a slip-on rear section that will fit to the stock center section or the optional Akrapovic Evolution center section. Carbon fiber-trimmed exhaust tips are included.

This system is made from a proprietary titanium. This is not the imitation titanium found on cheap exhausts - this is real titanium alloy that is proprietary to Akrapovic and produced in their own foundry. This titanium is three times stronger than other titanium, 40% lighter than stainless steel, and will not rust or corrode.

Akrapovic sound is distinctly European and exotic. Engineers tune every tube, muffler, and tail pipe to complement the powertrain. Many other vehicle parameters, such as vehicle speed, rpm, exhaust gas temperatures, and vibrations, are measured and correlated with the sound output to avoid unwanted vibrations or resonances. They further tune the exhaust to produce a thoroughly refind exhaust note that complements and accentuates the BMW engine.

In addition to sound tuning, engineers monitor exhaust gas flow and backpressure to improve performance and horsepower without affecting fitment or sound. Prototypes go through flow testing, dyno testing, and road testing to ensure there is no loss of power and that the optimal blend of sound and performance is achieved.

The Optional Header (SS) is targeted at owners looking for increased performance and weight reduction from motorcycles already equipped with an Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Carbon) exhaust. The Optional Header (SS) is constructed from high-grade stainless steel and provides a 53.5% (1.8 kg) weight saving in comparison to the standard stock header. Developed with larger diameter tubes to allow improved gas flow with less restriction, the catalytic converter of the stock header is removed to add to the flow.

When fitted with the Slip-On Line (Carbon), power is increased by 1.6 kW (2.2 hp) at 9,500 rpm, with a torque increase of 3.5 Nm at 6,700 rpm when compared to a Honda CB750 Hornet equipped with the standard stock exhaust system and tested on the Akrapovič in-house dyno. Producing a deep, racing sound fully encompassing the twin-cylinder engine, the Optional Header (SS) is an easy plug-and-play installation, with remapping recommended, but not mandatory. It is a racetrack-oriented part and as such is intended for use on closed-course competition circuits only.

Fitting of the optional header will invalidate the EC/ECE certificate for the Slip-On Line (Carbon).

Developed and tested by Akrapovic’s top factory teams by riders at the pinnacle of racing, it is simply the finest performance exhaust system available. Each Akropovic exhaust is dedicated to maximizing the performance of an engine, while reducing overall weight, to optimize the handling of your motorcycle. The key feature of the Akrapovic EVO Exhaust System is the full titanium header and mid-pipes. This saves the maximum amount of weight possible compared to an OEM exhaust or even a stainless steel exhaust system.

It’s not just about peak power - Akrapovic exhaust systems deliver increased performance throughout the entire RPM range. Increased power and torque result in a much smoother ride. In addition to the extra performance and weight-saving improvements, the Evolution Line also has the unmistakable Akrapovic sound, which adds to the desirability of both the exhaust and the machine.

Featuring a completely new design, this system has a double conical muffler and link pipe that perfectly integrate with the bike’s style. Constructed from high-grade stainless steel with black-coated mufflers, the exhaust is finished with a laser-engraved Akrapovič logo. Weighing just 3.0 kg, 55.8% lighter than the standard stock system, it has been developed for use on closed-course competition circuits only.

Its racetrack-oriented design increases power by 1.6 kW (2.2 hp) at 8,600 rpm and torque by 3.0 Nm at 4,500 rpm when tested on the Akrapovič dyno and compared to a Scrambler with a standard stock exhaust, and it serves up a deep, sporty, and vivid sound. A simple plug and play installation with no remapping required, the system fits on the Urban Motard, Nightshift, Icon, Icon Dark, and Desert Sled versions of the Ducati Scrambler.
The exhaust can be further enhanced with the addition of optional headers, and an optional carbon-fibre heatshield is also available.
For those clients installing the exhaust system on Desert Sled model, it is mandatory to buy the original Ducati mount kit 96481551A.

The product is developed and tested on EU vehicle specification. Non-EU fitment may vary by marketplace and different vehicle specification. On non-EU Ducati Scramblers the previous Akrapovič Slip-On Line S-D8SO4-CUBTBL/1 and optional headers E-D12E5 would fit.

 This product is a brand new underbelly complete exhaust system fabricated using high-grade stainless steel with a hand-made carbon-fibre cover that features honeycomb exhaust protection, a reminder of the racing DNA of Akrapovič. The cover is the final touch to the design, and it includes an Akrapovič logo in red and white.

This complete exhaust system comes as one unit with the catalytic converter inside the header. High-end technology was used when shaping the exhaust, with the aim of integrating the system within the bike’s lines. The weight has been reduced over the stock system by 50.9 % (1.4 kg).

During the development phase, the engineers focused on optimal throttle response and performance, leading to a power increase of 0.8 kW (1.1 hp) at 8200 rpm and a torque rise of 0.8 Nm at 7900 rpm when compared with a Honda CBR650R with a standard stock exhaust system and verified on the in-house dyno. It delivers a deep and sporty sound from the engine.
This product is Euro 5+ compliant and EC/ECE type approved with a plug-and-play installation and no remapping required.
This exhaust system does not fit with original Honda under cowl for CB650R.

This product is constructed from sandblasted 25 mm titanium tubes for lower weight and improved corrosion resistance. It is approximately 40% lighter than comparable stainless-steel versions, but it still offers the same high-strength mechanical properties. It weighs 3.02 kg, making it one of the lightest protection bar sets on the market for the BMW R 1300 GS / R 1300 GS Adventure. Developed to protect the motorbike’s engine, the construction is partly fixed to the chassis to distribute any impact. It is designed to integrate with the bike’s components and has been fully evaluated through numerous tests and deformation analyses. Precisely engineered with the Akrapovič attention to detail, this protection bar set has no restriction on the lean angle and it meets ABE type approval.

Carbon-fibre protection elements 2.5 mm thick provide structural strength and give the end user the option to change these parts if they are damaged. It is precision TIG welded and equipped with laser-cut and finely machined 10 mm flanges to provide a perfect fit and strength. The set is finished with an engraved Akrapovič logo, with the word Titanium prominently displayed to emphasize the use of this material. When fitted, the protection bar set offers the option to attach extra bags and fog lights or spotlights from BMW and other manufacturers to the bars.

We recommend that the Protection Bar Set (Titanium) be installed by a qualified mechanic.

Developed as an upgrade to complete a full system when paired with the Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) exhaust, this header is constructed from high-grade titanium with a carbon-fibre heatshield. Intended exclusively for closed-course competition circuits only, it enhances performance and reduces weight. Tubes with a bigger diameter than the standard stock system and removal of the catalytic converter allow for enhanced gas flow. The pre-muffler offers a unique sound experience, producing a deep racing tone from the boxer engine. This upgrade results in a 54.84% (3.4 kg) weight reduction compared to standard stock. When combined with the Slip-On Line (Titanium), it boosts power by 3.1 kW (4.2 hp) at 7,800 rpm and torque by 5.9 Nm at 3,000 rpm, as tested on the Akrapovič dyno against a BMW R 1300 GS equipped with a standard stock system. Installation is plug-and-play, but remapping is mandatory.

The optional header is also compatible with the Akrapovič standard (first fit) / BMW Motorrad accessory Akrapovič silencer. With installation of the Optional Header (Titanium), ECE type approval for the Slip-On Line (Titanium) is no longer valid.

This is a newly designed titanium muffler with an imprinted finish for additional strength and durability. A weight saving of 32% (1.3 kg) over the standard stock system, a deep sound, throttle response, and aesthetics are all aspects the engineers focused on in the development process. It is constructed with a high-grade titanium muffler outer sleeve and finished with a carbon-fibre end cap and high-grade stainless-steel link pipe, muffler inner structure, and heat shield. A power increase of 0.3 kW (0.4 hp) at 8,750 rpm and a torque rise of 0.3 Nm at 5,000 rpm have been recorded when compared with a standard stock exhaust and tested on the Akrapovič dyno. Plug-and-play installation means no remapping is necessary. It meets EC/ECE type-approval certificate - Euro5+, the new regulation from 2024 onward. The previous regulation, Euro5, was valid until 31 December 2023.
